For ever blessed be the Lord
For ever blessed be the Lord,
He sends his Spirit with his word
To arm me for the field.
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 144:1–2, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle. 2He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me. PSALM 144:1–2 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 144
For ever blessed be the Lord, My Saviour and my shield; He sends his Spirit with his word To arm me for the field. STANZA I
